lead.message: We're Paysprout, an AP automation SaaS (150 staff) selling into the US. We want a GTM engineering partner to build and run our outbound data pipeline: account lists from our ICP, enrichment, intent signals and CRM sync. We're looking at a monthly retainer of about USD 8-10k starting in January. I'm VP Revenue and can sign.
